Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent production pixel-art sprite sheet for a couple budget dashboard called DUIT. The input image is a STYLE AND CHARACTER REFERENCE ONLY, not a background to reproduce. Match its cozy 16-bit arcade art: dark plum/navy outlines #211B32, limited flat colors, crisp chunky square pixels, no gradients, no smoothed edges, no vector curves. True transparent alpha background. No backdrop, no labels, no text, no grid lines, no shadows on the ground. Exactly FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows, total EIGHT sprites, one full-body character in each cell. Image canvas landscape 1536 by 1024 if possible, cells 384 by 512. Each figure small and centered in its cell with generous empty transparent margins. All frames share identical scale, anatomy, face, outfit, camera, centered x anchor and feet baseline within each cell. The actual figure should be about 32 pixels wide by 48 pixels high at a logical pixel scale, upscaled cleanly. Front-facing with a slight three-quarter turn, cute large head, tiny body; human face, simple black dot eyes, no glasses.
Row 1, columns 1 through 4: IDLE LOOP: neutral open eyes; the same neutral eyes half closed; eyes closed blink; same neutral open eyes. No changes of costume or orientation. Tiny one-pixel shoulder breathing only.
Row 2, columns 1 through 4: WAVE: neutral with right arm low; right forearm raised; right hand above shoulder waving; right forearm lowered halfway. Keep feet planted and body unchanged. No additional hearts or particles.
Subject: HANZ exactly inspired by the green-shirt boyfriend beside DUIT in the reference. Short side-swept dark navy hair with a small purple highlight, warm light tan skin, a simple emerald green short-sleeved t-shirt #5F9E71, dark navy trousers, dark shoes. Masculine young adult, friendly. Same outfit in all 8 frames.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent production pixel-art sprite sheet for DUIT, a cozy couple spending dashboard. Input image is a character and art style reference only. Match the tiny orange tabby Chu Chu next to Vanisa and next to DUIT: cute bright ginger cat, dark warm plum outline, cream muzzle, cream chest and paws, triangular ears, orange tail with darker stripes, simple black dot eyes. Style is crisp 16-bit pixel art, flat solid colors, hard square pixel corners, small color palette. No gradients, no glow, no cast shadows, no labels, no text, no grid lines. True transparent background everywhere outside sprites.
Exactly FOUR equal columns by THREE equal rows: twelve frames total, centered in equally sized cells on a 1536x1536 canvas. One cat per cell, whole silhouette visible, very generous empty padding, same character model and fur markings in all frames. Logical sprite design about 40x36 pixels with crisp nearest-neighbor upscale.
ROW 1: four front-facing SEATED IDLE frames. Frame 1 eyes open tail at rest; frame 2 eyes half closed tail tip to right; frame 3 eyes closed tail tip at rest; frame 4 eyes open tail tip to left. Same body pose and paws baseline.
ROW 2: four side-view WALK RIGHT frames forming a loop, all facing right, same body outline scale and head height, plausible alternating short legs: contact pose, down/passing, opposing contact, up/passing. Tail curled upward. Keep the cat centered and feet on the same baseline; no translation between frames.
ROW 3: four curled-up SLEEP frames, side view facing right, head resting on paws, eyes closed, tiny one-pixel rise/fall in breathing. Frame 1 rest; frame 2 little inhale; frame 3 inhale; frame 4 rest. No Z letters or dream bubbles.
CRITICAL: entire source canvas is transparent, no colored backdrop, no atmospheric haze, no glows. Pixel outlines are opaque and crisp. All cats fully contained within their grid cell.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: decorative transparent header skyline asset for a pixel UI. Input image is only the visual reference. Create a single coherent wide 16-bit pixel-art sunset streetscape matching the small skyline at the upper right of the reference dashboard: warm terracotta and coral shophouse buildings, golden square windows, teal and sage tropical trees, one brown park bench toward the left and one toward the right, small dark street lantern with golden lamp at the far right, and a pixelated coral upper/yellow lower setting sun above the middle-right. Malaysian cozy shophouse feeling. Dark plum #211B32 chunky outlines, coral #F26F73, terracotta #DD795F, teal #62B6BB, foliage #5F9E71, gold #F6CB45. Flat color blocks only, crisp low-resolution pixels, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no realistic texture. No humans, no cat, no text, no logos, no game HUD, no moon, no floating confetti.
Canvas wide 1536x1024, the streetscape itself is a compact horizontal strip occupying the central band (approximately 1400px wide and 300px high) with empty transparent margin above and below. All buildings and trees sit on a single flat thin dark-plum ground baseline. Background fully transparent, sun visible as a separate shape through transparent sky, no filled sky rectangle. No glow or haze. This artwork will be trimmed to visible bounds and rendered as a small header ornament around 360px wide.
